blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Monday said the government is committed to protecting the youth from school violence and providing parents and communities with the knowledge and resources to prevent such incidents. He made the remark during the Recognition of Programme for International Student Assessment (PISA) Participating Schools and Education Partners at President Corazon “Cory” C. Aquino National High School in Pasay City.
